title: My own website
blurb: A one-page site with your name, what you do, a photo gallery and how to reach you.
best_for: A personal page, a small business, a shop, a CV you can send as a link.

asks.label: What should it be called?
asks.help: This becomes the title at the top of the page, and the folder name.

asks.label: One line about it
asks.placeholder: Fresh bread every morning, baked in Smalltown since 2019.

asks.label: A short paragraph about it
asks.placeholder: We are a family bakery. We bake sourdough, cinnamon buns and birthday cakes to order. Come in any weekday morning.
asks.default: This page is mine. I can change every word of it, and this paragraph is written in the file called index.html.

asks.label: Drop in photos (you can add more later)

changing: The words on the page are in web/index.html - open it in Notepad or TextEdit, change the text between the tags, save, then refresh the page. Nothing else needs to change.
The colour is at the top of web/style.css, on the line that starts with --accent.
Photos can be dropped straight into the photos folder. Refresh the page and they appear.
To put it on the internet later, everything in the web folder can be uploaded to any web host, as it is.

map.run.bat: double-click to start it on Windows
map.run.sh: double-click to start it on macOS or Linux
map.start.py: the small program that runs the page
map.serve.py: the engine (you never need to open this)
map.web/app.js: the photo gallery, and the only moving part
map.photos/: your pictures - add or remove any time
